hero.title: UNLOCK: Create Beyond Boundaries
hero.subtitle: The AI & Young Professionals Summit & Innovation Challenge

about.summary: UNLOCK is an AI workplace innovation challenge and grand expo run with iCEP at UiTM Shah Alam. Ten teams (five University Student teams and five Young Professional teams) join a 3-week virtual incubation sprint, then showcase working prototypes at the physical UNLOCK Summit on 7 December 2026.
objectives: EDIT: Build practical applied-AI skills for students and young professionals
EDIT: Turn workplace problems into working AI prototypes
EDIT: Connect young talent with industry

prepare: Team leader's full name, email and WhatsApp or phone number
Team name and the names of all 5 members
Proposed project title and a short description of the innovation
Confirmation that all members agree, agreement to the rules, and PDPA consent
steps: Team leader completes the Student or Professional form (once only)
You receive a confirmation email with your registration ID
Complete the member-confirmation form from that email
Join the WhatsApp group shown at the end of registration
Attend the Saturday sprint sessions and submit your deliverables

timeline.title: Registration closes
timeline.detail: First come, first served. Only 5 team spots per category.

timeline.title: Week 1: Kickoff & Framing
timeline.detail: Virtual soft launch, Applied AI Literacy in the Workplace, Virtual Meet 1 on modern AI prototyping tools, task scenario draw, 1-page proposal kickoff.

timeline.title: Week 2: System Architecture
timeline.detail: Virtual Meet 2: turn problem statements into technical briefs, then wireframe system logic, user flows and interface models.

timeline.title: Week 3: Prototype & Selection
timeline.detail: Virtual Meet 3 on refinement and testing. Industry panels (including iCEP) evaluate all 10 prototypes. Top 3 Student and Top 3 Young Professional teams are chosen for the live pitch. All 10 teams advance to the exhibition.

timeline.title: Grand Finale & UNLOCK Summit
timeline.detail: Dewan Annex / Dewan Seroja, UiTM Shah Alam.

zones.d: Industry talk sessions, the live final pitch of the Top 6 teams (3 Student and 3 Young Professional), then the grand awards ceremony.
All 10 teams set up interactive project booths for delegates, industry visitors and evaluators.

summit.passportText: Visitors follow the UNLOCK Passport (Onboarding, Exploration, Redemption) to visit all 10 booths and redeem rewards.
summit.peoples: People's Choice Award: summit delegates vote directly across all 10 exhibition booths.

awards.label: Official Trophies
awards.d: Top 3 Student teams and Top 3 Young Professional teams

awards.label: Appreciation Hampers
awards.d: Top 6 teams plus the People's Choice winners

awards.label: Finalist Medals
awards.d: All 50 talents who complete the incubation and exhibition

submissions: Working AI prototype / proof of concept

items: Active university students (undergraduate and postgraduate) join the Student Category. Early-career working adults join the Young Professional Category.
Each participant joins one team and one industry track only.
Solve a realistic workplace challenge with applied AI inside one of the 6 tracks.
Show the problem, a working AI architecture, user workflows and measurable business impact.
Original design work. Disclose all third-party models, APIs and frameworks.
Not allowed: plagiarism, fabricated survey data, unverified system claims, private or confidential company data without clearance, malicious applications.
Projects must comply with the PDPA. No unencrypted personal records, credentials or proprietary databases.

Disqualified for: intellectual property infringement, not disclosing core AI-generated code, fabricated results, late delivery outside approved sprint windows, or unapproved absence from required checkpoints.
Professional conduct is required at all virtual workshops, mentor clinics and on-site summit venues.

faqs.a: Active Malaysian university students (undergraduate and postgraduate) join the Student Category, and early-career working adults join the Young Professional Category.

Only the team leader registers, once, using the Student form or the Young Professional form in the Register section. Then confirm your members with the second form from your confirmation email, and join the WhatsApp group at the end.

faqs.q: Should every team member fill in the registration form?
faqs.a: No. Only the team leader or an authorised representative fills in the main form, to avoid duplicate team records. Members complete the member-confirmation form later.

faqs.kw: team size members pasukan how many spots
faqs.a: The cohort has 10 teams (50 talents): 5 Student teams and 5 Young Professional teams. Every team has exactly 5 members.
Customer Experience & Support, HR & Talent Operations, Operations & Productivity, Marketing & Content, Data & Decision-Making, and Sustainability & ESG. Each team picks one.

faqs.kw: when date tarikh schedule timeline deadline
faqs.a: Registration closes in late October 2026. The sprint runs on Saturdays 7, 14 and 21 November 2026, and the Grand Finale and UNLOCK Summit is on Monday 7 December 2026.
The Grand Finale is at Dewan Annex / Dewan Seroja, UiTM Shah Alam. The 3-week sprint is online.
Week 1: kickoff, applied AI literacy and prototyping tools. Week 2: system architecture and wireframing. Week 3: prototype refinement and finalist selection.
Innovation and Originality 20%, AI Integration & Technical Soundness 20%, Problem Relevance 15%, Feasibility 15%, Scalability & Impact 15%, Pitch and Demo 10%, Future Potential 5%.

faqs.kw: prize award trophy hamper medal hadiah
faqs.a: 6 official trophies (Top 3 per category), 9 appreciation hampers (Top 6 teams plus People's Choice winners) and 50 commemorative finalist medals for every participant.

faqs.q: What do we have to submit?
faqs.a: A 1-page proposal, technical architecture and wireframes, a working AI prototype, a pitch deck (10-minute talk, 5-minute Q&A), a booth setup for Zone B, and the AI-Use Declaration.
An official form explaining which AI tools, models and APIs you used and how you prompted them. All third-party tools must be disclosed.

faqs.q: Who pitches live at the finale?
faqs.a: The Top 3 Student teams and Top 3 Young Professional teams pitch live on the Main Stage (Zone A). All 10 teams exhibit at booths in Zone B.
An interactive visitor journey (Discover, Engage, Validate, Unlock) that takes delegates through all 10 team booths, with rewards to redeem.

faqs.q: How does the People's Choice Award work?
faqs.a: Summit delegates vote directly across all 10 exhibition booths.

faqs.q: What is Zone A and Zone B?
faqs.a: Zone A is the Main Stage conference with talks, the final pitch and the awards. Zone B is the exhibition floor where all 10 teams run interactive booths.

faqs.q: Can I join more than one team?
faqs.a: No. Each participant joins one team and one track only.

faqs.q: Can we use private company data?
faqs.a: Not without clearance. Projects must follow the PDPA, with no unencrypted personal records, credentials or proprietary databases.
IP infringement, not disclosing core AI-generated code, fabricated results, late delivery outside approved windows, or unapproved absence from required sprint checkpoints.
Registration fees, if any, are non-refundable.

faqs.q: How do I join the WhatsApp group?
faqs.a: The link appears at the end of the registration process. Official updates are also sent by email.
iCEP is the Anchor Industry Partner and Strategic Advisory Lead, and its industry panel helps evaluate the prototypes.
